SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT prs_id) AS sales_rep_count
FROM wwicryptic.ap.t_ppl
WHERE is_sls IS TRUE

sql:
SELECT g.byn_grp_id, g.byn_grp_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT i.inv_id) AS invoice_count
FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_inv i
JOIN wwicryptic.sl.t_cst c ON c.cst_id2 = i.cst_id2
JOIN wwicryptic.sl.t_byn_grp g ON g.byn_grp_id = c.byn_grp_id
GROUP BY g.byn_grp_id, g.byn_grp_nm
ORDER BY invoice_count DESC

question: How many countries are in Europe?

FROM wwicryptic.ap.t_cnt

What was our gross margin in dollars in each calendar year, going by invoice date? Show the year and the margin.
How many orders did we take in each month of 2015? Show the month number and the number of orders.
By what percentage did invoiced revenue before tax grow from 2014 to 2015, going by invoice date? Round to one decimal place.
sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM trn_dt) = 2015 THEN amn_exc_tax END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM trn_dt) = 2014 THEN amn_exc_tax END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM trn_dt) = 2014 THEN amn_exc_tax END), 0), 1) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_cst_trn
WHERE inv_id IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM trn_dt) IN (2014, 2015)

question: How much money did we receive in customer payments between January 1 and March 31, 2016?
How many cold room temperature readings went above 4.5 degrees in February 2016?
Who were our top 5 customers by invoiced revenue before tax in 2015? Count each store on its own, not rolled up to its head office. Show the customer name and the revenue.
sql:
SELECT cst_id, nm AS customer_name, SUM(amn) AS revenue_before_tax
FROM wwicryptic.lg.t_c_r_m_inv_arc
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crt_at) = 2015 AND amn IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cst_id, nm
ORDER BY revenue_before_tax DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Which sales rep brought in the most invoiced sales including tax in 2015? Show their full name and the amount.
What are our top 10 products by units invoiced, all time? Show the product name and the units invoiced.
What share of our invoiced revenue before tax comes from refrigerated products? Give it as a percentage rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ctg, '') ILIKE '%refriger%' OR COALESCE(nm, '') ILIKE '%refriger%' OR COALESCE(dsc, '') ILIKE '%refriger%' OR COALESCE(ctg, '') ILIKE '%chiller%' OR COALESCE(nm, '') ILIKE '%chiller%' OR COALESCE(dsc, '') ILIKE '%chiller%' THEN amn ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(amn), 0), 2) AS refrigerated_revenue_share_pct
FROM wwicryptic.lg.t_fnn_tax_cds
LIMIT 500
